{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ears of the Chiroptix''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] spell that gave the user increased hearing capabilities. It allowed to hear "whispers" and to, in essence, ''see with sound'' by painting pictures of hidden places from the sounds emanating from those places.

This technique was allowed during the Nightsister's [[Test of Night]]. The name originated from the [[chiroptix]], a creature from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] with a keen sense of hearing.

==Behind the scenes==
The Ears of the Chiroptix technique shares similarities with the [[Wikipedia:Animal echolocation|animal echolocation]]&mdash;the use of echoes to detect objects as observed in [[Wikipedia:Bat|bats]] and other natural creatures.
